text: No, the 2023 tree removal was not authorized. The observed loss (0.7 ha) was below the 0.5-ha minimum event threshold due to 0.4 ha being in small patches. The area was planted forest (Eucalyptus), not native forest, but the loss still violates Uruguay’s forest law, which prohibits clearing planted forests under 1 ha without authorization. No authorization records were found for this event.
